activity_summary: You listed what should have been packed where a hand could reach it. The tables were under the shirts. The quire was at the bottom. You were sore from one o'clock and had said so to nobody. You stopped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the list to no one and ended it.

facets.activity: Found the tables under the shirts and the quire at the bottom

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
